title_en: Psychology Made Simple (8/20): Three Minutes of Deep Breathing
note_en: 他越想，心跳就越来越快 combines two patterns: 越…越… "the more... the more..." (越想 "the more he thinks") and 越来越 + adjective "more and more" (越来越快 "faster and faster"). English uses comparatives (-er, more) for both, but Chinese adjectives don't change form; 越 placed in front of the verb or adjective does all the work.
